formats.key: TransferWithAuthorization(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 validAfter,uint256 validBefore,bytes32 nonce)
effects: Once anyone submits the signed authorization, exactly `value` USDC moves from the signer (`from`) to `to` (EIP3009._transferWithAuthorization calls _transfer(from, to, value)).
The authorization works only when validAfter < block time < validBefore (_requireValidAuthorization).
The signer's nonce is marked used, so this authorization runs only once (_markAuthorizationAsUsed).
formats.shown: "Authorize USDC transfer", then From, To, Amount in USDC (the token resolved from the verifying contract) and the Valid after / Valid before dates. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: TransferWithAuthorization: the intent line has no amount or recipient because there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats TransferWithAuthorization: "intent": "Authorize USDC transfer", and interpolatedIntent is absent. The amount and recipient appear only in the fields 'Amount' and 'To' (for example case 2: '0.3 USDC' to 0x402F…B0d4).

findings.title: TransferWithAuthorization: validAfter = 0 shows as '1970-01-01 00:00:00Z' instead of 'immediately'.
findings.evidence: cases 0-4 screen: 'Valid after' = '1970-01-01 00:00:00Z'. EIP3009._requireValidAuthorization: require(now > validAfter), so 0 means the authorization is valid right away. The date format has no message for the value 0.
